LF64Sub1: Sets up the tile window parameters (d0 position, d1 size) for a text box.
LF64_1: Draws the page selected by d0 (1 or 2, otherwise the default page).
LF64_2: Fills the picture buffers with the background pattern.
LF64_3: Adds d0 to the Y position of all 80 sprite entries.
LF64_4: Builds the portrait tile data from the source at $70(a6).
LF64_5: Copies the tile buffer to $BC000 and queues the VRAM upload.
LF64_6: Picks the picture pointer for index d0 (page A or B).
LF64_9: Decodes the picture at (a0) into the tile buffer.
LF64_10: Unpacks 4-bit pixel data from $50(a6) into the buffer.
LF64_11: Draws the selected picture into the tilemap.
LF64_12: Draws the career statistics rows from $44(a6).
LF64_16: Prepares the buffers and shows the current picture.
LF64_17: Blits a rectangle into the buffer at $BC000.
LF64_21: Converts d7 to packed BCD in d1 (abcd loop).
LF64_22: Packed BCD conversion that counts the overflow in d2.
LF64_23: Chooses the source pointers for the current page.
LF64_24: Queues a DMA request in the $DE-$E4 block and waits for it.
LF64_25: Copies a rectangle of tilemap data to the VDP.
LF64_26: Turns the VRAM address in d4 into a VDP write command.
LF64_30: Sends the font load command through the gate-array registers.
LF64_32: Decodes pad 1 and computes newly pressed buttons.
LF64_33: Decodes pad 2 and computes newly pressed buttons.
LF64_34: Inverts the raw pad byte and splits direction and button bits.
LF64_35: Saves the vblank vector and points it at the page handler.
LF64_38: Turns a linear cell index in d0 into a nametable address (40 columns).
LF64_39: Prints a zero-terminated string with the special characters at a0.
LF64_40: Prints a string at a4 (stops at 0 or $FF).
LF64_41: Copies at most d0 characters of a0 to the string buffer $8E(a6).
LF64_42: Spins until the word-RAM DMNA bit is set.
LF64_43: Sets the word-RAM request bit and waits until it is granted.
LF64_44: Loads a command through the gate-array comm registers.
